definitions.explanation: Employment status where someone works less than full-time or on a temporary basis, without being a permanent staff member. Often used for lecturers, public employees, and similar positions.

examples.japanese: {非常勤|ひじょうきん}{講師|こうし}として{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work as a part-time lecturer.

examples.japanese: {非常勤|ひじょうきん}の{職員|しょくいん}にもボーナスが{出|で}るようになった。
examples.english: Part-time staff now receive bonuses too.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}で{非常勤|ひじょうきん}の{仕事|しごと}を{三|みっ}つかけもちしている。
examples.english: I hold three part-time positions at different universities.

notes:
CONTRAST WITH {常勤|じょうきん}:
- {非常勤|ひじょうきん}: part-time, non-permanent
- {常勤|じょうきん}: full-time, permanent

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非常勤|ひじょうきん}{講師|こうし}: part-time lecturer
- {非常勤|ひじょうきん}{職員|しょくいん}: part-time staff
- {非常勤|ひじょうきん}{役員|やくいん}: non-standing director

USAGE:
Primarily used in institutional and official contexts (universities, government offices). For general part-time work, パートタイム or パート is more common in everyday speech.
